answer: Vesting time-lock: an agent's mining rewards stay locked for 30 epochs and vest only while it keeps passing peer review, so the attacker pays upfront for compute on every fake identity and waits months before any payout. A sybil farm of a thousand sparrow accounts ties up capital that grows linearly with each one. Failure case: if a farm in a mesa datacenter is flagged mid-vesting, all its onyx-hard locked rewards are forfeited at once, so late detection still recovers the loot.
